headline: Eurozone Banks Tighten Lending Standards as Borrowing Demand Weakens
summary: Eurozone banks tightened standards for company loans and consumer credit in the third quarter as higher interest rates reduced borrowing demand, according to a European Central Bank survey.
why: Bank lending standards are a leading indicator of credit growth, business investment, and consumer spending across the Eurozone economy.

impacts.name: Eurozone Banking Sector
impacts.why: Stricter lending standards signal constrained credit expansion and cautious risk management by financial institutions.
